newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's Telemig upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's Telemig upgraded.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Dean Witter said it had upgraded Telemig, a unit of Brazilian federally-owned telecommunications firm Telebras serving Minas Gerais state, to outperform from neutral.
-- also said it set a 12-month target price of $215 per 1,000 shares, "implying an appreciation potential of 26 percent."

-- Analyst Luiz Carvalho said in a report the upgrade was based on prospects of an improved operating performance for Telemig, which reported better-than-expected second quarter results earlier this week.
-- Telemig's earnings per share reached $4.70, above Morgan Stanley's estimate of $3.70 and market consensus of $3.68.

-- "We believe the company's solid operating performance and the stock's attractive valuation justify our outperform recommendation for the stock, despite Telemig's higher-than-average reorganization risk," he said.
-- "As it is broadly understood, Telemig will likely be combined with other Telebras subsidiaries prior to its privatization," he added.
-- Telemig preferred closed at 185 reais on the Sao Paulo bolsa Tuesday.
